func divisorCount(number: Int) -> Int {

    var temp = number
    var count = 1
    
    // Handle factors of 2
    while temp & 1 == 0 {

        temp /= 2

    // Handle odd factors

            temp /= factor

    }
    
    // Handle remaining prime factor
    if temp > 1 {
        count *= 2
    }
    
    return count
}
